concerns: The default random pause simulator uses a non-configurable Random, which might make testing pause timings more verbose in future integrations.
The concurrent hashmap taskTracker is in-memory only; if the server restarts or clustering is introduced, the status of active imports would be lost.
OpenAiLlmClient uses a raw Map mapping for JSON response parsing, which lacks compile-time type safety compared to a structured DTO class.

verdicts.criticalReason: PR commits database files (data/appdb.mv.db) and Java build/compilation artifacts (target/ directory), which must be excluded.

concerns: IgnoredChat has a hardcoded LocalDateTime.now() inside its fields, which could make assertions against creation times non-deterministic depending on test clock settings.

verdicts.criticalReason: PR commits internal orchestrator files under .eneik/records/, which violates core boundaries and causes automatic rejection.

concerns: The fixedDelay in WarmupWorkerJob is hardcoded (60000 and 120000), making it difficult to configure or speed up intervals for different environments.
The Svelte App component implements in-line styles and non-relative margin units in some Tailwind utility classes, which can be cleaned up in a future layout review.
